### God Knows the Big Picture
Author: Marybeth Whalen
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/encouragement/encouragement-for-today-july-21-2008-11579437.html
Passage: Exodus 29:46
Points:
- God told the Israelites to take gold and valuables from the Egyptians, an instruction that seemed awkward and impractical for travelers.
- Later instructions for building the tabernacle revealed that God had planned ahead to supply the materials for His dwelling among them.
- Even when circumstances seem confusing, believers can trust that God already prepares what is needed for His purposes.
- Submitting to God's broader perspective brings peace and courage when facing life's uncertainties.
